主要内容: On January 22, 2016, SAP SE issued a press release announcing its preliminary financial results for the fourth quarter and full year ended December 31, 2015. The press release is attached as Exhibit 99.1 and incorporated by reference. The document highlights non-IFRS financial measures, which are not prepared in accordance with IFRS and should be considered in addition to, not as substitutes for, revenue, operating income, cash flows, or other financial performance measures. The report also includes forward-looking statements, which are subject to risks and uncertainties. These statements are based on SAP's filings with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, including its most recent Annual Report on Form 20-F for 2014. The provided text is a Form 6-K filing by SAP SE, dated January 25, 2016. It includes the signatures of Christoph Huetten and Christopher Sessar, who are authorized representatives of the company. The filing references a press release dated January 22, 2016, which is included as Exhibit 99.1. This document is part of the regulatory reporting requirements under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. The filing indicates that SAP SE has fulfilled its obligations by signing the report on behalf of the registrant.
